description: This file defines a custom Android View named SlidingTabStrip, which manages the visual representation and behavior of sliding tabs within a tab layout. It handles drawing indicators, dividers, and borders, and manages color customizations and view updates related to tab selection and position changes.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: Custom view class for rendering and managing sliding tab indicators, dividers, and borders within a tab layout.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the indicator colors for the selected tab, removing any custom colorizer.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets the colors of dividers between tabs, removing any custom colorizer.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset when the pager page changes.
